data.description: The Bucket Spinner is a single light blue bucket seat mounted on a red tilted post. A child sits inside the bucket and spins, and the tilt of the post makes each turn rise and dip a little. The deep seat holds the child securely, which is why it suits the 3 to 6 years Key User Group. Only one child rides at a time, so it works best as one of several small pieces in a nursery or society play corner rather than the main attraction. The seat comes in Baby Blue. Our standard warranty gives 3 years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts and 1 year on bearings. Ask us where a Bucket Spinner would fit beside your existing equipment.

items.pText: The Bucket Spinner is a single light blue bucket seat mounted on a red tilted post. A child sits inside the bucket and spins, and the tilt of the post makes each turn rise and dip a little. The deep seat holds the child securely, which is why it suits the 3 to 6 years Key User Group. Only one child rides at a time, so it works best as one of several small pieces in a nursery or society play corner rather than the main attraction. The seat comes in Baby Blue. Our standard warranty gives 3 years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts and 1 year on bearings. Ask us where a Bucket Spinner would fit beside your existing equipment.

props.pText: The post is galvanised steel and the bucket seat is roto-moulded, so neither rusts in wet weather. Installation is self-standing or grouted. The spin depends on its bearing, so check at every maintenance visit that the seat turns smoothly. Leave clear space around it so a turning child cannot strike a nearby frame.
